records.title: Does Self-Attention Need Separate Weights in Transformers?
records.reason: A shared-weight self-attention BERT learns one QKV matrix, halving parameters and cutting training time; parameter sharing is compression-adjacent, but the work is an architecture/training study, not an inference technique.

records.title: ALW: Adaptive Layer-Wise contrastive decoding enhancing reasoning ability in Large Language Models
records.reason: ALW contrasts layer-wise probability distributions during decoding to reduce noise accumulation and improve reasoning; a decoding method, but aimed at answer quality rather than inference efficiency or serving.

records.title: Half-S: Halving the Scale for Near-Lossless 4-Bit LLM Training
records.reason: Half-S derives optimal FP4 scaling to train LLMs at 4-bit precision near-losslessly; training quantization only, with no inference application stated.

records.title: Quantized LLMs for Clinical Report and Question Answering in Retinal Disease Assessment
records.reason: Fine-tunes a compact LLaMA for diabetic-retinopathy reports and QA and evaluates its Q4 GGUF quantization on CPU; an application deployment study of a clinical model, not a general inference technique.

records.title: Adaptive-VoCo: Complexity-Aware Visual Token Compression for Vision-Language Models
records.reason: Adaptive-VoCo predicts per-input visual token compression rates for VLMs, extending VoCo-LLaMA beyond a fixed rate to cut visual compute and memory; direct inference token compression for VLMs.

records.title: Text Compression Algorithm Based on Feedback Self-Optimization Using Lightweight LLMs
records.reason: A two-stage framework uses lightweight LLMs to select salient text units and regenerate compressed summaries; text summarization application where 'compression' is of documents, not of the model or its inference.

records.title: Enabling Resource-Efficient On-Device Fine-Tuning of LLMs Using Only Inference Engines
records.reason: Repurposes on-device inference engines (ExecuTorch) with zeroth-order optimization to fine-tune LLMs on edge devices; it exploits inference infrastructure, but the purpose is training/personalization, not inference efficiency.

records.title: AVAM: A Universal Training-Free Adaptive Visual Anchoring Embedded into Multimodal Large Language Model for Multi-Image Question Answering
records.reason: Adaptive Visual Anchoring compresses visual tokens for multi-image VQA in MLLMs with flexible token counts; token reduction serves a QA application and is framed as an accuracy-efficiency plug-in, not a serving system.

records.title: Toward an Unbiased Collective Memory for Efficient LLM-Based Agentic 6G Cross-Domain Management
records.reason: Studies retrieval bias in a shared collective memory for LLM agents doing 6G RAN-edge orchestration and defines a Retrieval Bias Index; agent memory analysis for a network-management application, not an inference system.

records.title: DCFT: Dependency-aware continual learning fine-tuning for sparse LLMs
records.reason: DCFT fine-tunes post-training-pruned sparse LLMs continually while preserving sparsity, treating interacting matrices jointly; it maintains an inference-relevant sparse model, but the contribution is a continual fine-tuning method.
